facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Brisbane's CBD, overlooking the Brisbane River.
facts.excerpt: located in the vibrant heart of Brisbane's CBD, overlooking the iconic Brisbane River

facts.text: Each suite offers panoramic Brisbane River views.
facts.excerpt: Each one offers panoramic Brisbane River views, bespoke amenities, and a vibe that fuses the buzz of the city with a laid-back luxury feel.

facts.text: Suites have a 10-gallon drum bathtub with bath treatments by Retreatment Botanics.
facts.excerpt: a 10-gallon drum bathtub with luxury bath treatments by Retreatment Botanics

facts.text: Penthouse I is on the top floor with panoramic views of the Brisbane River to the mountains.
facts.excerpt: Penthouse I is located on the top floor of the hotel and exudes panoramic views of the Brisbane River all the way to the mountains and beyond.

facts.text: Penthouse I has a fully equipped bar and a large dining space.
facts.excerpt: complete with a fully equipped bar, large dining space and state-of-the-art technology

facts.text: Curvilinear shapes inspired by the river run through the hotel's design.
facts.excerpt: Curvilinear shapes mimicking the ebb and flow of the river weave through the 5-star hotel in Brisbane CBD

facts.text: The heated WET pool on the fourth floor has panoramic views of Brisbane City.
facts.excerpt: stay cool at our Brisbane hotel with a heated pool, located on the fourth floor, featuring panoramic views of Brisbane City.

facts.text: The WET Deck rooftop bar offers sunsets, handcrafted cocktails, light bites and DJ sets.
facts.excerpt: The rooftop bar in Brisbane is the ultimate spot for vivid sunsets, handcrafted cocktails, light bites and DJ sets.

facts.text: AWAY Spa on Level Five offers body treatments and relaxation pods.
facts.excerpt: Located on Level Five of our hotel, our serene AWAY® Spa welcomes you with indulgent body treatments, relaxation pods

facts.text: The FIT gym on Level Six has Brisbane skyline views and TechnoGym equipment.
facts.excerpt: FIT is our 130-square-metre state-of-the-art hotel gym on Level Six boasting supreme views of the Brisbane skyline and TechnoGym® equipment

facts.text: The Whatever/Whenever service can arrange a helicopter ride to Byron Bay, a rugby game from an exclusive box or a lesson with a pro surfer.
facts.excerpt: Take a Heli ride to Byron Bay, enjoy a rugby game from the comfort of an exclusive box or sign up for an expert lesson with a pro surfer

facts.text: A music curator and resident DJ play the Living Room Bar and WET Deck weekly.
facts.excerpt: our dedicated music curator and resident DJ bring energy to the Living Room Bar and WET Deck weekly

facts.text: The Lex is a New York-style steak restaurant.
facts.excerpt: signature restaurant The Lex, a New York-style steak restaurant in Brisbane putting a modern spin on classic favourites

facts.text: South Bank is about a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Only a short 10-minute walk from the hotel

facts.text: The Queensland Art Gallery and Gallery of Modern Art (QAGOMA) is just across the river.
facts.excerpt: Queensland Art Gallery and Gallery of Modern Art (QAGOMA) is conveniently situated just across the river from W Brisbane.

facts.text: Queen Street Mall is a 600-meter walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Queen Street Mall is situated just a 600 meter walk away from the doors of W Brisbane.

facts.text: Penthouse II has a separate living room, a dining area and a bathtub with a dual shower.
facts.excerpt: this luxury escape includes a separate living room, dining area, and a lavish bathtub with a dual shower.

facts.text: One pet is allowed per room, up to 18 kg.
facts.excerpt: One pet is allowed per room, with a maximum weight of 18.0 kgs.

facts.text: Self-parking is in a third-party garage in the same precinct.
facts.excerpt: The third-party Brisbane Quarter Wilson garage with paid self-parking is in the same precinct.
